data.title: 砂狼白子 · 居室床榻的棉麻吊带凝视
data.description: 阿拜多斯宁静的宿舍卧室内，夜风轻拂窗纱。白子只穿着一件浅蓝色的简约棉质细吊带背心，银白色的短发略带蓬松凌乱，狼耳微微耸立。她跪坐在单人床褥上，双手放在大腿上，面容清秀如冰雪初融，浅蓝色的眼眸直直地凝视着你，眼神中透着毫无杂质的执着信任与让人怦然心动的纯净诱惑。
data.action: kneeling upright on bed in simple pastel blue cotton camisole, wolf ears standing alert, short silver hair messy, bare shoulders, calm intense gaze at viewer with slight blush
data.location: spartan clean bedroom in Abydos dorm in soft moonlight
data.lighting: pale desert moonlight washing through window onto white bedding
data.mood: pure unvarnished wolf-girl devotion, silent intense connection
data.promptProse: Kneeling quietly upon a clean bed in soft moonlight, Sunaookami Shiroko wears a simple light blue cotton camisole. Her wolf ears perk alertly as her crystal blue eyes hold an unwavering, tender gaze.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko kneeling on a moonlit bed in a light blue camisole with alert wolf ears.
